newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs seen steady - private sources.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs seen steady - private sources.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices were seen steady on Thursday amid perceptions that marketings had increased enough to cover packer needs, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.
Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts Tuesday matched the day's estimate of 100,000 head, USDA reported. Estimates for Wednesday also were 100,000 head.
"Movement was nothing big, but it was enough for the demand," one Indiana dealer said. "Looks like it will be the same for tomorrow," he said.
